name: EBF transcription factor 2

function.text: EBF2 is the approved symbol for EBF transcription factor 2. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; positive regulation of cold-induced thermogenesis.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Glioblastoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: EBF2 encodes EBF transcription factor 2. Its functions include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EBF2 have been reported in glioblastoma, cutaneous melanoma, and endometrial carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
